tools.name: mcp.context
tools.description: Current live identity, revision and permission.

tools.name: project_get
tools.description: Read the authoritative native project, revision and shared history.

tools.name: project_load
tools.description: Replace the current project with validated project data. Unsaved edits require an explicit discard flag.

tools.name: edit_batch
tools.description: Atomically execute the native core's typed MIDI edit commands. Uses the current MCP revision guard.

tools.name: history_undo
tools.description: Undo through the native editor's shared history.

tools.name: history_redo
tools.description: Redo through the native editor's shared history.

tools.name: project_list
tools.description: List saved Cantabile projects in the configured workspace.

tools.name: project_save
tools.description: Atomically save the current project, or Save As a new workspace name ending .cantabile.json.

tools.name: project_open
tools.description: Open a saved workspace project; requires an explicit discard flag for unsaved edits.

tools.name: midi_import
tools.description: Import at most 1 MiB of base64 SMF data through the native MIDI parser; requires explicit unsaved-edit handling.

tools.name: midi_export
tools.description: Export the current native project as an immutable MIDI artifact. Read bytes with file_read.

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read up to 128 KiB of one session-owned exported file with per-chunk and whole-file SHA-256.

tools.name: file_list
tools.description: List immutable exports retained in this workspace, including recovered exports after restart.

tools.name: file_release
tools.description: Permanently release one exported artifact and its metadata to reclaim the bounded export quota. Never deletes projects.

tools.name: instruments_list
tools.description: Read configured legacy backends and the installed VST3 catalog. Detection, load/inspection and audibility are separate; module paths remain private to this host.

tools.name: audio_render
tools.description: Snapshot the native project to an asynchronous job. Catalog assignments render aligned float32 stems and a float64-summed PCM16 mix; any active unassigned/missing instrument fails explicitly. Projects without catalog assignments retain the legacy backend.

tools.name: audio_status
tools.description: Read render job state and complete immutable WAV metadata.

tools.name: audio_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one current host-owned audio render job.

tools.name: vst_inspect
tools.description: Read the configured VST 3 instrument's public parameters, MIDI mappings, buses, programs and interfaces as JSON in an isolated bounded worker.

tools.name: vst_script
tools.description: Run a bounded version-1 JSON VST script with inspect, list_parameters and get_parameter only. No file bindings or writes.

tools.name: vst_script_write
tools.description: Run allowed VST parameter, MIDI/render and state operations after Inspector validation. Requires edit permission, current guard and host CANTABILE_VST3_SCRIPT_WRITE opt-in. Current project MIDI is input.mid; files binds existing MIDI/state artifact IDs to safe basenames. Outputs publish only on success.

tools.name: vst_scan
tools.description: Start an asynchronous scan of standard VST3 locations and operator-registered CANTABILE_VST3_PATHS. One isolated worker per module/class; failures are retained. Poll vst_job_status.

tools.name: vst_job_status
tools.description: Read a host-owned scan, script, capture or multi-instrument job, including bounded rollback/audit failure summaries and immutable completed artifacts.

tools.name: vst_job_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a host-owned scan, script, capture or multi-instrument job. An isolated worker's rollback is unknown after a hard kill.

tools.name: instrument_assign
tools.description: Assign a catalog VST3 to a MIDI track, resetting its previous sound state. Each track is an independent instance. Uses native Undo/Redo; no host restart.

tools.name: instrument_clear
tools.description: Remove a track's instrument assignment and stored state through native Undo/Redo.

tools.name: instrument_state_set
tools.description: Copy a completed standard state artifact into the native track instance. Checks class identity; saved projects embed state (max 1 MiB/instance within project quota). The next async render applies it explicitly.

tools.name: instrument_state_import
tools.description: Import an operator-selected standard VST3 preset (base64, max 1 MiB) into one assigned track. Checks container/class and commits one native edit; resets stale sound/performance identity. Does not read arbitrary paths or certify sample availability.

tools.name: vst_script_begin
tools.description: Start a bounded asynchronous write script on a track instance (or legacy configured instrument). Requires SCRIPT_WRITE opt-in. Poll vst_job_status for outputs or typed rollback/audit summary; use instrument_state_set to retain a saved state.

tools.name: sound_performance_set
tools.description: Attach versioned, bounded performance declarations to a saved sound's expected state digest. MIDI numbers are 0..127; retain sources and operator evidence. Search returns the declarations; existing edit/Script tools execute documented controls. Matching capture artifact IDs may attach host-observed output evidence. This never infers anonymous automation meanings.

tools.name: sound_register
tools.description: Retain a private independent copy of a track's standard state or state artifact. Returns a stable sound ID; never exposes state bytes or local paths. Registration does not certify audible restoration.

tools.name: sound_search
tools.description: Search individual saved sounds by category, role, tag and verification. Returns availability, state digest and loading conditions, never paths or state payloads.

tools.name: sound_assign
tools.description: Atomically apply one saved sound and its loading conditions to a native track. One Undo/Redo entry; mixer settings remain independent. Unverified restoration is reported, never implied by assignment.

tools.name: sound_preview
tools.description: Render a saved state with original fixed melody, bass or drum notes in an isolated async job. Preserves the current project, revision and history. Poll audio_status/vst_job_status; cancel with audio_cancel/vst_job_cancel; retrieve mix/stem using file_read.

tools.name: sound_verify
tools.description: Record explicit operator evidence separately for initial audibility, restored audibility and human review. These are attestations, not automatic tests or proof of preset identity.

tools.name: sound_remove
tools.description: Delete one retained sound using its expected state SHA-256. Existing project copies and already-started previews retain their snapshots. Not undone by native project history.

tools.name: vst_capture_begin
tools.description: Snapshot one assigned track, input MIDI and saved state for bounded asynchronous VST3 event-output capture. Does not edit or reinject into the project. Poll vst_job_status.

tools.name: vst_capture_preview
tools.description: Read capture status, provenance and up to 64 output events from matched immutable MIDI/report artifacts. Never changes the project.

tools.name: vst_capture_import
tools.description: Explicitly append captured MIDI to a new muted, unassigned native track. Validates artifact pairing and current tempo/meter/PPQ; preserves source/provenance with one Undo/Redo entry. Never overwrites a track.

tools.name: kontakt_library_list
tools.description: List metadata for operator-registered Kontakt content roots, then bounded .nki/.nksn file names and opaque IDs in one selected library. Never returns absolute paths, patch bytes or sample data. Discovery is not license or loading verification.

tools.name: kontakt_prepare_begin
tools.description: Prepare one explicitly selected registered .nki and optional compatible .nksn in a fresh visible Windows Kontakt 7/8 VST3 editor via fixed generated official Lua. Requires local PREPARE opt-in and Kontakt Developer features. Does not operate existing apps or accept scripts/paths. Poll vst_job_status; apply the resulting standard state explicitly before render/shelf registration.
